A does more damage: it rewrites the whole stylesheet and changes values it had just called fine, such as the h2 margin and the .amounts margin. B keeps its fix to a specific label gap and its other suggestions are lighter, though it still nitpicks button heights and the spacing scale. | pass 2 (A=without, B=with): Both answers catch the label-gap bug and explain it correctly.
